Name: Adopt Manfred the Skeleton
Author: Akatra
Description:
[center][img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMng2ZmVuNGoxbHNzaWdwdGoyd3VqZHZ4YWUwbHllZ21sa3Uyemp5MyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Fu8aV5rjbJyed459Ck/giphy.gif[/img]﻿

﻿﻿Adds Manfred from [i]Dragon Age: The Veilguard[/i] as a custom pet available for purchase in Marnie’s shop.
Doesn't replace existing pets![/center]
After creating a replacer mod to replace the Wizard with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30755]Emmrich Volkarin (Rasmodius Wizard Replacement)[/url]﻿, I couldn’t resist adding Manfred too! Manfred is a standalone pet and doesn’t replace any existing pets. You can adopt him from Marnie as soon as you get your pet license (after reaching full friendship with your first pet and getting Manfred his own water bowl. Don't forget to feed your skeleton, [i]I'm watching you[/i]).

In the future, I’d love to make Manfred accessible through his own questline, tied closely to one of the Wizard's, but that will have to wait since I’m still just starting out. Manfred will wander about your farm, stumble into bushes, and play rock-paper-scissors for fun. When you reach full friendship with him, he’ll even surprise you with green tea now and then!

[b]Requirements:[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b]Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ (For those who have never modded SDV, here is a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkohJW_TFRg]guide[/url]﻿)
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿
[*]Download my mod and extract it into your mod folder.
[*]Enjoy!﻿﻿
[/list]
